goal.sl: Poveš, kaj se dogaja prav zdaj (I'm walking, she isn't sleeping), vprašaš What are you doing? in ločiš to od tega, kar delaš vsak dan (Jack walks the dogs every day).
goal.de: Du sagst, was gerade jetzt passiert (I'm walking, she isn't sleeping), fragst What are you doing? und unterscheidest es von dem, was du jeden Tag tust (Jack walks the dogs every day).
goal.it: Dici che cosa succede proprio adesso (I'm walking, she isn't sleeping), chiedi What are you doing? e lo distingui da quello che fai ogni giorno (Jack walks the dogs every day).
goal.en: You can say what is happening now (I'm walking, she isn't sleeping), ask What are you doing? and tell it from what you do every day (Jack walks the dogs every day).

say.sl: Za to, kar se dogaja prav zdaj, je **am**, **is** ali **are** + glagol na **-ing**: **I'm walking.** (Zdaj hodim.) **Jack is walking the dogs.** (Jack ravno sprehaja pse.) **They're playing.** (Igrajo se.) Be je tak kot vedno: **I'm**, **she's**, **we're**. Slovenščina tu reče kar sedanjik, angleščina ne.
say.de: Für das, was gerade jetzt passiert, steht **am**, **is** oder **are** + das Verb mit **-ing**: **I'm walking.** (Ich gehe gerade.) **Jack is walking the dogs.** (Jack führt gerade die Hunde aus.) **They're playing.** (Sie spielen gerade.) Das be kennst du schon: **I'm**, **she's**, **we're**. Deutsch sagt hier das Präsens, oft mit gerade.
say.it: Per quello che succede proprio adesso c'è **am**, **is** o **are** + il verbo con **-ing**: **I'm walking.** (Sto camminando.) **Jack is walking the dogs.** (Jack sta portando fuori i cani.) **They're playing.** (Stanno giocando.) Il be è quello che conosci: **I'm**, **she's**, **we're**. È come stare + il gerundio.
say.en: For what is happening now, at this moment: **am**, **is** or **are** + the verb with **-ing**: **I'm walking.** **Jack is walking the dogs.** **They're playing.** The be is the one you know: **I'm**, **she's**, **we're**.

say.sl: Zapis: večina glagolov samo doda **-ing**: **walk**, **walking**; **read**, **reading**. Neizgovorjeni **e** odpade: **make**, **making**; **come**, **coming**. Kratek glagol z enim samoglasnikom in enim soglasnikom ga podvoji: **sit**, **sitting**; **run**, **running**; **swim**, **swimming**. In **lie** (ležati), **lying**.
say.de: Die Schreibung: die meisten Verben hängen nur **-ing** an: **walk**, **walking**; **read**, **reading**. Ein stummes **e** fällt weg: **make**, **making**; **come**, **coming**. Ein kurzes Verb mit einem Vokal und einem Konsonanten verdoppelt ihn: **sit**, **sitting**; **run**, **running**; **swim**, **swimming**. Und **lie** (liegen), **lying**.
say.it: L'ortografia: quasi tutti i verbi aggiungono solo **-ing**: **walk**, **walking**; **read**, **reading**. La **e** muta cade: **make**, **making**; **come**, **coming**. Un verbo corto con una vocale e una consonante la raddoppia: **sit**, **sitting**; **run**, **running**; **swim**, **swimming**. E **lie** (stare sdraiato), **lying**.
say.en: Spelling: most verbs just add **-ing**: **walk**, **walking**; **read**, **reading**. A silent **e** drops: **make**, **making**; **come**, **coming**. A short verb of one vowel and one consonant doubles it: **sit**, **sitting**; **run**, **running**; **swim**, **swimming**. And **lie**, **lying**.

say.sl: Primerjaj s present simple za to, kar delaš pogosto ali vedno: **Jack walks the dogs every day.** (Jack vsak dan sprehaja pse.) Danes, zdaj: **Today Sam is walking them.** (Danes jih sprehaja Sam.) **now** (zdaj), **at the moment** (ta trenutek), **Look!** in **Listen!** gredo z **-ing**; **every day** (vsak dan) in **usually** (navadno) s preprosto obliko.
say.de: Vergleich es mit dem present simple für das, was du oft oder immer tust: **Jack walks the dogs every day.** (Jack führt die Hunde jeden Tag aus.) Heute, jetzt: **Today Sam is walking them.** (Heute führt sie Sam aus.) **now** (jetzt), **at the moment** (im Moment), **Look!** und **Listen!** gehen mit **-ing**; **every day** (jeden Tag) und **usually** (normalerweise) mit der einfachen Form.
say.it: Confrontalo con il present simple per quello che fai spesso o sempre: **Jack walks the dogs every day.** (Jack porta fuori i cani ogni giorno.) Oggi, adesso: **Today Sam is walking them.** (Oggi li porta fuori Sam.) **now** (adesso), **at the moment** (in questo momento), **Look!** e **Listen!** vanno con **-ing**; **every day** (ogni giorno) e **usually** (di solito) con la forma semplice.
say.en: Compare the present simple, for what you do often or always: **Jack walks the dogs every day.** And now, at this moment: **Today Sam is walking them.** **now**, **at the moment**, **Look!** and **Listen!** go with **-ing**; **every day** and **usually** with the simple form.

say.sl: Glagoli **know** (vedeti), **like** (imeti rad), **want** (hoteti), **need** (potrebovati) in **understand** (razumeti) povedo, kaj veš, imaš rad ali hočeš, ne kaj delaš. Ti nimajo -ing, tudi zdaj ne: **I know.** **I want a cup of tea.** **I understand.** Nikoli *I'm knowing*.
say.de: Die Verben **know** (wissen), **like** (mögen), **want** (wollen), **need** (brauchen) und **understand** (verstehen) sagen, was du weißt, magst oder willst, nicht was du tust. Sie haben kein -ing, auch nicht jetzt: **I know.** **I want a cup of tea.** **I understand.** Nie *I'm knowing*.
say.it: I verbi **know** (sapere), **like** (piacere), **want** (volere), **need** (avere bisogno) e **understand** (capire) dicono che cosa sai, ti piace o vuoi, non che cosa fai. Non prendono -ing, neanche adesso: **I know.** **I want a cup of tea.** **I understand.** Mai *I'm knowing*.
say.en: The verbs **know**, **like**, **want**, **need** and **understand** say what you know, like or want, not what you do. They don't take -ing, even now: **I want a cup of tea.** **I understand.** **I know.** (never *I'm knowing.*)
